_comment: SOAR playbook rules. First matching rule wins. See docs/soar-playbook.md for the reasoning behind every tier and threshold.

rules.reason: Pipeline self-test; proves ingest, bus, playbook and actions all run.
Sample or test finding: never act on it automatically.
Miner process on an office host: confirmed compromise, contain the host.
Host is trying to spread: isolate before it reaches the next host.
Archive-and-upload by a process: confirmed data theft, cut the host off.
An office host scanning the network is reconnaissance from inside: isolate it.
5+ failed logins from an internal host in 5 min: credential guessing from inside.
Internet scan of the office: block the source for an hour at the edge.
10+ failed logins from one internet address in 5 min: block it for an hour.
High-severity IDS signature from the internet: block the source.
High-severity IDS signature from an office host (for example a mining check-in).
GuardDuty high severity on a cloud instance: isolate it.
A few failed logins: worth a look, not worth a block.
Statistical anomaly is a soft signal: notify only.
Behavioural network signal without host proof: notify only.
Medium severity without a specific playbook: notify.
Low severity: keep for investigation only.
